encoding: zlib+base64 of row-wise differences (mod 256), row-major, W x H; decode: inflate, then running sum mod 256 along each row
scale: q/255 = percentile rank (0..1) of the group among the ROI's 18 m CRISM pixels (mean of member-parameter ranks, re-ranked)

hydrated.label: Hydrated minerals
hydrated.meaning: BD1900_2: 1.9 um H2O band depth; bound molecular H2O except monohydrated sulfates

sulfates.label: Hydrated sulfates
sulfates.meaning: SINDEX2: convexity at 2.29 um from 2.1 and 2.4 um absorptions; mono- and polyhydrated sulfates

monosulfates.label: Monohydrated sulfates
monosulfates.meaning: BD2100_2: 2.1 um shifted H2O band; monohydrated sulfates

gypsum.label: Gypsum / alunite
gypsum.meaning: BD1750_2: 1.75 um H2O band depth; gypsum, alunite

femgclay.label: Fe/Mg clays
femgclay.meaning: D2300: 2.3 um drop-off, hydroxylated Fe,Mg silicates; BD2290: 2.29 um Mg,Fe-OH band (also CO2 ice, not expected here)

alclay.label: Al clays / kaolinite
alclay.meaning: BD2165: 2.165 um Al-OH band, pyrophyllite, kaolinites; MIN2200: Si-OH doublet, kaolinites

opal.label: Silica / opal (Si-OH)
opal.meaning: MIN2250: 2.21 and 2.26 um Si-OH bands; opals

ferric.label: Ferric oxides (incl. hematite)
ferric.meaning: BD530_2 and BD860_2: Fe3+ absorptions at 0.53 and 0.86 um; together they flag crystalline hematite

olivine.label: Olivine
olivine.meaning: OLINDEX3: broad absorption near 1 um; olivines

pyroxene.label: Pyroxene
pyroxene.meaning: LCPINDEX2: broad absorption near 1.8 um; HCPINDEX2: broad absorption near 2.12 um; low- and high-Ca pyroxene

dropped.BD920_2: Fe2+ and Fe3+ absorptions 0.4-1.02 um, mixed meaning; not assigned to one mineral class

provenance.source_method: per-pixel nanmedian of the 3 products' SU stacks
provenance.method: percentile rank within the ROI per parameter, mean over the group's parameters, re-rank, bilinear resample of the 18 m pixels to the twin 4.047 m grid by proportional mapping (as build_twin_demo.py)
provenance.meanings: Viviano-Beck et al. 2014, JGR Planets 119:1403-1431 (summary products table)
provenance.caveat: CRISM maps minerals from orbit, not elements; 18 m pixels; a strong signal is a lead to check, not a confirmation. No detection threshold is applied.
